**Section D: Composition Writing (10 marks).** Write a composition of between 250-300 words on any ONE of the topics below.

**Topic 1.** You have noticed with dissatisfaction that most people in your community do not respect the necessary measures taken by the government of your country to fight COVID-19. Most of them say that COVID-19 does not exist in your country. Some of them say it's government's strategy to get money from WHO. On the occasion of the celebration of the International Health Day, you as a youth leader of your community have decided to sensitise the people on the importance of respecting the measures the government has put in place to fight COVID-19. Write a speech in which you explain what COVID-19 is, where it originated from, symptoms and preventive measures, why you think it is persistent, and the measures people in your locality are using to prevent or cure it.
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
La rédaction anglaise du BAC série A évalue à la fois le respect du format imposé (discours, composition, lettre personnelle) et la qualité du contenu. Les sujets 2 et 3 abordent des thèmes sensibles — le deuil consécutif à un accident de la route, et l'alcoolisme/tabagisme d'un proche — qui doivent être traités avec sobriété et bienveillance, sans dramatisation ni jugement moral excessif, en se concentrant sur les éléments factuels demandés par la consigne (causes, conséquences, conseils de santé). Le sujet proposant un choix, un seul texte doit être rédigé le jour de l'examen.

## Topic 1 - Speech (modèle, environ 280 mots)

Ladies and gentlemen,

On this International Health Day, I stand before you not merely to mark an occasion, but to address a concern that affects the health and safety of every household in our community: the widespread refusal, by many among us, to take COVID-19 seriously.

Let me begin with the facts. COVID-19 is a respiratory illness caused by a coronavirus first identified in Wuhan, China, in late 2019, before spreading rapidly across the world. Its symptoms typically include fever, persistent cough, fatigue, and loss of taste or smell, though severity varies considerably from one person to another. It spreads mainly through respiratory droplets released when an infected person coughs, sneezes or speaks in close contact with others.

I understand why some of you doubt its existence here, or suspect it is merely a strategy to attract funding from international organisations such as WHO. But dismissing the virus does not make it disappear; it only makes us more vulnerable to it. I believe the disease persists in our community partly because of this very denial, which leads people to abandon basic preventive measures.

The good news is that simple measures remain effective: regular handwashing with soap, wearing a mask in crowded places, maintaining physical distance where possible, and getting vaccinated when the opportunity arises. In our locality, some households have adopted these habits, particularly handwashing and mask-wearing at the market, but far too many have not.

I urge each of you today to set doubt aside and adopt these measures, not out of fear, but out of respect for the health of your own family and neighbours. Protecting one another starts with each of us.

Thank you.

**Section D: Composition Writing (10 marks).** Write a composition of between 250-300 words on any ONE of the topics below.

**Topic 2.** You are very sad because some of your family members were involved in a ghastly motor accident and they all passed away leaving behind young children. Write an essay in which you talk about the major causes of road accidents, its consequences to the relatives and the country as a whole, and the measures the government of your country and individuals could take to solve the problem of road accidents.
questions.corrige_markdown:
## Topic 2 - Composition (modèle, environ 270 mots)

*Note pédagogique : ce sujet évoque le deuil de plusieurs membres de la famille dans un accident de la route. Le corrigé propose un traitement sobre et factuel, centré sur les causes, conséquences et solutions demandées par la consigne, sans dramatisation inutile.*

Losing several members of one's family in a single road accident is a pain that reshapes how one sees everyday life, and it has made me reflect deeply on why road accidents remain so frequent in our country, and what can be done to prevent them.

Several factors explain the high number of accidents on our roads. Over-speeding remains one of the most common causes, particularly on long, poorly monitored stretches of highway. Poor road conditions, including potholes and inadequate lighting, also play a significant role, as does the poor state of many vehicles still allowed to operate despite obvious mechanical faults. Human error, including driving under the influence of alcohol, fatigue, and the growing habit of using a phone while driving, further compounds these risks.

The consequences of these accidents extend far beyond the immediate victims. Families are left to grieve the sudden loss of parents, siblings or children, often while also caring for surviving dependants, such as young children left behind. For the country as a whole, road accidents represent a considerable loss of human capital and place a heavy burden on hospitals and emergency services, in addition to the economic cost of damaged vehicles and infrastructure.

To address this problem, government should enforce stricter roadworthiness inspections and speed limits, supported by visible and consistent policing. On an individual level, drivers must commit to basic discipline: respecting speed limits, avoiding alcohol before driving, and never using a phone at the wheel. These changes, though simple, could save countless families from experiencing the loss my own family has known.

**Section D: Composition Writing (10 marks).** Write a composition of between 250-300 words on any ONE of the topics below.

**Topic 3.** Your uncle by name Vally smokes cigarettes. He also drinks beer and sachet whiskey like "Fighters" and "Gold Bond". He always looks drunk and tired. Many of your family members have talked to him but he still drinks and smokes. Write a letter to him informing him about his present state and the dangers of drinking sachet whiskey and smoking. Your name is Bih Alice and your Post office box number is 798.
questions.corrige_markdown:
## Topic 3 - Personal letter (modèle, environ 250 mots)

Bih Alice
P.O. Box 798

Dear Uncle Vally,

I hope this letter finds you well. I am writing because I have noticed, along with several other family members who have already spoken to you, that you have not been looking like yourself lately: tired, often unsteady, and, if I may say so honestly, frequently drunk.

I know that cigarettes and drinks like "Fighters" and "Gold Bond" sachet whiskey may feel like a way to relax or cope with life's pressures, but I am worried about what they are doing to your health and to how our family sees you. You seem more tired than I have ever known you to be, and it troubles me that this has become a daily pattern rather than an occasional habit.

I want you to know some of the real dangers involved. Cigarette smoking significantly increases the risk of lung cancer and other serious respiratory diseases. Sachet whiskey, in particular, is often produced with little regulation, and drinking it regularly, especially in large quantities, can seriously damage the liver and other organs, sometimes with fatal consequences that we read about far too often in the news.

Uncle, none of us are writing to judge you, only because we love you and want you around for many more years. If cutting back feels difficult on your own, please consider speaking to a doctor or a counsellor who can help you do it safely and gradually.

We are here for you, whenever you are ready to talk.

With love and concern,
Bih Alice

### Piège à éviter
Sur les sujets 2 et 3, l'erreur la plus pénalisée serait d'adopter un ton moralisateur, culpabilisant ou dramatisé à l'excès : la consigne attend un texte factuel et respectueux, centré sur les éléments demandés (causes/conséquences/mesures pour le sujet 2 ; état de santé et dangers pour le sujet 3), pas un texte misérabiliste.

### Conseil
Pour les sujets de santé sensibles comme la dépendance à l'alcool ou au tabac, structure toujours la lettre en trois temps : constat bienveillant de la situation actuelle, explication factuelle des risques encourus, puis ouverture vers une solution ou un soutien concret plutôt qu'un simple reproche.
